reviews.title: A very nice keyboard for typing and general productivity
reviews.comment: I've had this keyboard for a couple of weeks now. I use this keyboard for general productivity and typing, not for gaming. The sound made by this keyboard is pretty nice, a bit clicky, but in a good way. The touch is light and I can see getting faster on this than on my last low-end membrane keyboard. If I had to point out any faults, I'd say that the keys are a bit slick, these have no texture on them. If you do game and get sweaty hands that might be an issue, but it hasn't been for my use case. The other small issue is that the keys are slightly concave in design (many keycaps are), so I occasionally get my fingers caught moving from one key to the next key while typing. This might also be because my last keyboard had flat keys so I'm sure I'm still adjusting to the difference. Since this is a "renewed" product I assumed that there might be some light wear and tear on the base or the keys but mine looks and performs like it's new! While your specific keyboard may be a little different in terms of condition, I'm super pleased that I was able to save almost 40% off the new price. :)
reviews.author: E. Roberts

reviews.title: Awesome Ilumimation, HyperX Quality
reviews.comment: I understand that it is a refurbished product and it may be missing accessories such as the original box, have some signs of use or minor flaws. The Box is what matters least to me. The keyboard works correctly. It is clean and without signs of use. The only detail I found is that for some reason the internal memory of the keyboard to save lighting effects does NOT WORK. No effect is saved, so I can only change the effects with the HyperX NGENUITY Software and on some occasions the "FN" key doesn't work, but just disconnect and reconnect the keyboard and it works again. The truth is a very high quality keyboard for the price for which I got it. for which it is recommended 100%
reviews.author: Mario S.

reviews.title: Bought refurbished/renewed and got a great deal.
reviews.comment: I've used this keyboard for years, so I picked up another one to use at work. My first one had a ton of issues due to the Ngenuity software, but it's been perfect since that whole mess. I have one with aqua switches and one with reds. They both sound great and are smooth to type on.
